notes: Vermont adopted NGSS directly (September 2013). Vermont uses the standard NGSS documents from nextgenscience.org. No state-specific comprehensive PDF document. Vermont was an early NGSS adopter (#4 overall).
issues_encountered: State references nextgenscience.org for standards documents
adoption_details: Adopted September 2013 - fourth state to adopt NGSS
note_about_access: Vermont provides implementation resources and evidence-based practices guidance but uses standard NGSS documents from nextgenscience.org
